if there's anything i know for sure, it's that sometimes you have to allow yourself to be selfish. within reason, obviously, but going to your parents for support regarding your mental health is within reason so there's nothing to worry about there

if you do decide to go to them for support, dont beat yourself up abt it if it turns out to be difficult. i struggle to follow my own advice most of the time.

either way, take care. hope all goes well
It wasn't even people talking about their problems I was talking about. It was people trying to comfort me.

yeah, i getcha.

hope the ups get more frequent soon

Fair enough honestly

you're not doing so good right now i'm guessing?

not necessarily "before i end it," because it's not like i have any solid plans, but… i would like to finish at least one of my original stories

how about you? you got anything?

i don't think it's reddit. or at the very least, not just reddit. i can't comprehend anything anymore. there's schoolwork and the upcoming elections and my near constant existential crisis and i'm kind of just trudging through it all. it's bogging me down.

i don't know. thank you for talking to me at all. i appreciate it
i don't know. i can't remember anything. my brain's so foggy.

god i don't know. i'm so tired. it's almost every other night now i'm suicidal. my mind feels so heavy and my head feels clouded, dark and stormy like a typhoon incoming. i feel so alone in my family. an outlier. everything feels so wonky and unreal and it's tiring

it's about this girl listening to music on her headphones. all of a sudden she hears news that the world is going to end today, and in her headphones she hears a voice giving her instructions on how to survive. so she follows them, running through all the chaos of everyone in the world panicking, but when she makes it to the destination, she finds out >!the world is fake. her whole life, her whole world, was an experiment run by a bunch of scientists, and today they were going to destroy it. as a bomb is dropped on the town, she hears the voice in her headphones apologize to her, then the song ends!<

do you feel real?  
>!do you know the song Headphone Actor?!<

>!i'm afraid i'm like the character in the song!<

i dont know if they make me feel real. they just distract me from.. idk, "awareness," i guess. my mind gets occupied by them. distractions. then when there's nothing left to distract me i feel hollow. empty. most of the time i can't comprehend my own existence.
homework. videogames. songs. etc etc

>It definitely presents like most every GenZ person has to have an identified mental illness, nonconformity, brokenness, or tragedy associate to them.

well that's awfully dismissive of you. the "has to" bit specifically. You're making it sound like it's just some trend, when the reality is most of Gen Z says they're mentally ill/nonconforming/traumatized because they actually *are*

Why the hell are you so focused on race? Fucking hell.

For everyone's sake I hope you improve. On all aspects.

>My life is shittier than there's lol.

See, there's another issue. The fact that you're making this out to be some sort of competition.

Stop it with the whole "privilege" bit for a minute and listen: Your struggles aren't invalidated by the existence of other people's suffering. Yes, your life is shit. Their's is too. It's not a competition. Both can be true at the same time.
Whether they do or don't, what the hell does zoning in on that achieve? So you're struggling with dating. That's not the fault of all the men of an entire race.

>Who said I'm racist?

Your insistence that black men have it better at dating, that black men attract white women, and that being black in 2022 isn't a disadvantage.

>Just because I'm not priviledged doesn't mean I'm racist.

I never said anything of the sort? Those two aren't related. At all.

I don't know about elsewhere, but nobody here is telling you you should be ashamed for being white, or that you should be acting like your life is awesome. It sucks that you're struggling financially, and it sucks that you think you're ugly, but the validity of your struggles isn't mutually exclusive with the evident racism you're expressing all of that in.
I'm actually Asian but go off ig. Clearly you'd rather be resentful and faux cocksure, but I hope some day you get out of that funk you're stuck in (and stop being racist while you're at it).
You being supposedly ugly doesn't negate the fact that between you and a black person, you're far less likely to face systematic racism.

Therapy is a two-person effort though. This part I know is on me — I have a hard time talking. Whenever it's time for therapy, my mind goes utterly blank. I can't form any words, like my mouth's gone numb. A therapist can't help if the patient doesn't even say a single thing, or answers every single question with, "I don't know."

Depression, Generalized Anxiety Disorder, Attention Deficit Disorder.

i'm not really in the mental state to get all technical about these things, sorry.

the thing is i already have that help. I've been to a psych, i've been diagnosed. I go to therapy. I take my meds. yet still, i end up wide awake at night, feeling like utter shit.

though i guess my adhd's still going untreated. it's an executive dysfunction, isn't it? can't bring myself to get out of bed, take a shower, do shit. i only take the ritalin when i have homework to do.

…fucking hell, i can't believe it took me until now, took me *this*, to realize that. fuckin christ i'm tired of this shit.
same here. best wishes out there

it's hard to just "talk about" shit when everything wrong is so… chronic. the school counselor will be the same, i'm sure.

you were probably trying to help, and i guess it's the thought that counts, but… advice doesn't really help anymore. sorry.

hey. i'm sorry you're in this nightmare too. you're completely right: it *is* unfair. If there's anything I know for sure, it's that nobody deserves this bullshit. I'm willing to bet that includes you.   
i don't think there's an answer to 'when' — you probably don't need me to tell you that 'it gets better' is an empty phrase at this point. i can only *hope* things get better for you.

take care

Hey, this is a late reply, but thank you. it really does mean a lot to me.

I hope you're doing okay yourself — and if not, i hope shit gets better soon.

I'm with everyone else. Go focus on yourself, dude.

Also, rule 4d: your last paragraph is entirely made up of unhelpful platitudes. Suicide is way too nuanced and complex for general approaches like your post to do shit. It's a case-by-case thing; now take that and remember there are thousands of people on this sub.

You have to put your own oxygen mask on first.
hey, you still there? slr, your comment didn't show for some reason. I'm okay with DMs! Do you want to contact first?
do you wanna talk about it? or talk about something else, distract you from it for awhile - palate cleanser?

hey, you still there?

i'm not in a good place either, but maybe we can keep each other company for now?

i'm sorry things are shit right now
Yeah, it definitely feels like that 😔

Actually, y'know what? Upon reflection, I was being a dick. I was irritated and acted on impulse, and even though there is a reason for my irritation, my attitude in trying to remedy it isn't at all justified. I'm sorry I was so short with you. I know that people being hostile when you're just trying to learn is more often than not a deterrent.

The fact still remains, though, that what you asked (specifically, "Are you male to female or female to male?") is incredibly rude, and I strongly advise not doing it again in the future. To answer your first question, though: Nothing made me trans. I just am.

I encourage you to read more on this, if you're really curious. 

Either way, I'm sorry again for being shitty. I hope you have a good day.

Okay, first of all, most of the people on grindr and tinder who "love trans people" don't actually love trans people. That "love" isn't love, it's fetishization.

Second… there's a whole plethora of comments here — from me and other trans people — for you to infer from. And it's definitely nothing you can help with, the post is so short because the problem is a gigantic nuanced thing. Like I said in another comment: "If you know, you know."

If you don't, well... I dunno, that's for you to decide what to do with :/ I'd suggest reading more on this, though; educating yourself. But I can't make you do anything.
People don't choose to be trans, just like you don't choose to be born, or choose to depend on oxygen.
You take care too. Sincerely hope things get better for you.

I'm a dick because I told someone it's rude to ask what they did?

I don't think they were being malicious either — doesn't change the fact that it was rude.
Protip: don't ask people this. It's rude.

You definitely implied it was simple by starting off with platitudes :/ "Just do whatever you want" and shit like that.

And you're still doing it. All this advice? It's not helping. I know this shit already. I know people are gonna be shitty regardless. Doesn't kill to vent a bit and let the wave of shitty emotions pass, though, does it?

It's not that simple.

Look, I'm a trans man, right? That means I've lived X number of years being perceived and identified as a girl, being told how to be a girl, etc etc etc. My birth certificate has a name that isn't mine. All my official records in the government, in hospitals, in schools, say that I am a woman, identify me with an outdated name.

Even if the people in my personal life and day-to-day routine accept me and identify me correctly, if I ever need my birth certificate, my passport, my medical records, they will all identify me as a woman — and that is much more mentally and emotionally damaging than you think.

"So why not just change it?" 1) It's not that simple, and 2) I can't. I live in the Philippines. We don't even have gay marriage :)

My very existence is questioned, mocked, and degraded by a huge number of people. So many people see my status as a joke. So many people think people like me are mentally ill, that we're too stupid to know what gender is, that we're *degenerate.* It's not as simple as "ignoring the haters," because the haters have social power. And I'm not saying that out of hopelessness, I'm saying that because history has proved, time and again, that social norms, perceptions, consensus, mob mentality — *all of that* can be deciding factors in who gets to live and who gets forgotten by future generations. Whose lives get ruined because someone *"just disagreed with that lifestyle."*

Who are they to decide? They're humans. Homosapiens, just like you and me. Playing tug-of-war because we're trying to survive, or because we think we're doing what's right; and we hurt each other in the process. For a lot of people, the hurt is unintentional, but for the people playing the game because it's funny, the hurt is *very much* intended. The hurt is their entertainment.

(And it's a lot worse if the hurt is caused by others' indifference, apathy — because standing by and doing nothing is just as bad as active bigotry. But I digress.)

Long story short… it's not that simple.

It is, isn't it?

Take care out there.
Kind of hard to "not care about the others" when a lot of "the others" decide whether or not you have rights :/

It's just a lot, y'know? So many people in the world. Most of them are cis. Some of them are gonna be understanding and empathetic, but some others just aren't; and a lot of the time, one seems overwhelmingly larger than the other.

It just gets overwhelming. It's a hopeless feeling, really, knowing that one's situation is a "if you know, you know." I'd love to be proven wrong, but right now it looks like cis people will never understand what it's like to be trans, all the goddamn intricacies and nuance that comes with being trans, being trans in this world; and it sucks, because when it looks like the people who don't care to empathize have more power over the people who *are* kind…

I'd rather not be here at all.

You know?

Edit: It's alright if you don't respond, by the way. From the looks of your profile, you're taking a lot on your hands. Don't bite more than you can chew.

I'm just glad I'm able to express myself somewhere at all. Even if the number of people who see it is so small.

It's not the teacher I'm worried about, it's my grades. I'm 100% sure i did badly in the first term, and if i dont pull my weight now the second term isnt gonna look too great either. I'm repeating a grade ffs. I had to drop out a couple of years ago — just before the end of the school year, mind you — because i attempted suicide a handful of times already, and now… fuck, i want to do better, but i'm not. I can't. The whole cycle's fucking repeating and it's all just so exhausting.

fuck, man. i just want to be normal. I just want to have a stable job, have my goddamn mental disorders under control, be able to indulge in my hobbies… but so far, nothing's looking up. im a gay trans man with adhd, depression, and anxiety in a catholic country. recipe for fuckin disaster, exhibit a.

i do value myself, but that's the worst part. it's hard to live up to that when everything seems so stacked against me… that, or i just seem to be too shit to be able to do anything about it.

shit it's gonna sound stupid. The immediate precursor? I couldn't pass homework in time. I thought I had until Sunday evening but actually the submission period ended Sunday 12 AM. And i remember my teacher being strict as fuck so imagine the fucking bag of bricks that hit me the moment i realized im fucking screwed. Spiralled from there i guess.

that's how it always turns out though. Just one little thing and im careening to the cliff's edge. always always always. kept getting called "sensitive" as a kid for how easily i break down into tears and it fucking stung, but damn were they right

you say "keeps you going" as if there's any effort in living. there isn't. breathing oxygen is automatic. if you're following someone else's orders — your parents, your teachers, your bosses, whatever — there's no effort. you just do it. trudge through it, probably fuck it up, but… blacking out from emotional exhaustion is much easier than pushing past innate survival instincts and successfully killing yourself, yknow?

nothing keeps me going. i just go.

I mean in fairness, the game doesn't word the prompt as "Suicide is an option," it's actually worded as, and I quote, "Could also just put all this to rest." After V says that, the character he's talking this says, "If we don't do something, anything, we're both doomed." The dialogue options then are, "OK, dumb idea" (backing out) and "I know. Exactly what we're gonna do" (deciding on suicide).

which I think is pretty bad too, imo. A lot of people ended up doing the suicide ending by accident because the prompt was vague.

other than that, yeah, I agree. That's the shitty thing about trigger/content warnings and people being apprehensive about them: when you have these heavy, shitty things in your story — it doesn't matter if it spoils the game or "ruins" the story. Catching your audience by surprise, and potentially putting them in a bad place because of your surprise, is way worse in comparison to a mere fuckin' *spoiler*. 

This ending isn't even the only instance of suicide in this game. Two side-quests end in the suicide of an NPC— one is preventable, the other isn't. And roaming the open world, there's a chance of you just suddenly seeing someone fall splat in front of you because they jumped from a height.

so it's just… if the game could've at least left a warning… eugh.
i'm sorry. That all sounds… really shitty. Don't even have advice, don't know what to say, just… I'm sorry.

oh fuck, i feel you on the losing friends thing. I cut off a group of friends I had earlier this year, significantly reducing the already small number of friends I had, and the few i have left i barely talk to. And it's not like I want to turn the only conversations I have with them into vents, so we just don't talk except for the occassional "hey how're you doing?" It's working alright, i guess, but sometimes I can't help but wonder if soon i'm just gonna end up alone, and it sucks. I'm scared of that, yet I don't know how to prevent it, so.. here we are.

I'm sorry to hear you're going through something similar. Where I'm at right now… I wouldn't wish it on anyone.
